findings.title: Upright order opens a vertical provision field
findings.claim: Putting the Torah, the Gospel, and what was sent down to the community into an upright and maintained order is presented together with eating from above and below; the paired sources form a provision field around the community.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier أَقَامُوا۟ governs three revelation objects, while مِنْ فَوْقِهِمْ and مِنْ تَحْتِ أَرْجُلِهِمْ mirror one another in the promised result. The near-parallel establishment wording in 5:68 returns the order-setting act as a support relation.
findings.reader_payoff: The condition becomes a relation between how revelation is established and how provision is encountered: ordinary eating remains visible, while its sources occupy both an upper direction and a grounded lower boundary.
findings.containment: The plain conditional promise and actual eating remain intact. The registered branches are used only in this bounded contextual relation; no unrestricted dictionary family or unbounded cosmology is being asserted.

epistemic.reason: The focus surfaces and trusted branch nomination directly support the contact, while the synthesis joins several contextual facets and is not itself an adjudicated source conclusion.

branch_activations.carrier: The focus form أَكَلُوا۟ carries the ordinary act of consuming provision.

branch_activations.activation: The act of eating is placed as the concrete consequence of establishing the named revelations, so provision is read through the condition rather than as an isolated gift.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The community would consume actual sustaining provision when the revealed order is established.
branch_activations.boundary: This retains the ordinary eating sense and does not turn the verb into a general metaphor for every kind of consumption.

findings.title: Provision answers an extractive economy
findings.claim: The pericope lets the focus's eating promise answer an earlier pattern of illicit extraction: establishing revelation is heard as redirecting a damaged economy toward open provision and circulation.
findings.mechanism: The supplied sequence places illicit eating beside stripping away, faults learned leaders for failing to restrain it, and then contrasts a bound hand with an extended hand that spends. The focus establishment and eating carriers therefore meet a local reversal from devouring and blocked circulation toward receiving and distributing provision.
findings.reader_payoff: The promise of food gains an economic contour: it can be read as nourishment within restored circulation, while the focus still plainly states the conditional act and its result.
findings.containment: The economic redirection is an attributed contextual inference from exact coordinates. A live alternative remains that the focus promises bounty without specifying a human distributive mechanism; that alternative does not displace this reading.

epistemic.reason: All six anchor coordinates and roles are supplied, but five branch descriptors remain unresolved and the source record is legacy-unbound; the synthesis is therefore retained with attribution and containment.

epistemic.reason: The focus and 5:70 coordinates are exact, but the whole-field relation is an attributed HFT outlier and the packet explicitly marks the mapping as form-distant.
